summary: Enhance your skills with our Power BI training course. Learn data analysis and visualization techniques to transform your data into insightful reports.
lede: Power BI data analysis helps reporting professionals prepare information and build reports users can verify and act on. For foundation-to-intermediate analysts, developers, and reporting teams, the course covers cleaning data with Power Query, structuring reusable star-schema models, and creating DAX measures. It also covers accessible interactive dashboard design, publishing and refresh in Power BI Service, and governance practices for reliable reporting.
audienceIntro: This Power BI training course is designed for professionals who build, review, govern, or rely on analytical reports. It supports foundation-to-intermediate users who need a disciplined Power BI data analysis workflow rather than isolated chart-building techniques.
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate Power BI training course requires basic confidence working with tables, spreadsheets, filters, and common business metrics. Previous Power BI, DAX, SQL, database, or programming experience is helpful but not required. Coding is not required for completion, although you will write guided DAX expressions and use Power Query interface steps. Bring a laptop capable of running the latest stable Power BI Desktop release, with installation rights or software installed before training. Advanced topics such as Copilot, DirectQuery architecture, deployment pipelines, and gateway design receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than technical engineering depth.
